title: statblock_data_model.md
content:
# Stat Block Data Model

A stat block stores one ancestry or exactly two direct parents. Parent A uses `raceId` and `subtypeId`; Parent B uses `parentBRaceId` and `parentBSubtypeId`. Earlier ancestry and grandparents are not reconstructed.

`data/races.json` contains 130 canonical parent races and 106 canonical subtypes. `data/genetics.json` contains all 8,385 distinct parent-race pairs. Every pair includes `mode`, `rule_basis`, direct rule matches, and—when compatibility is inherited through closure—the shortest race-by-race compatibility path.

Same-parent heritage is resolved dynamically: both choices must be distinct subtypes classified as `bloodline`, `lineage`, or `ancestry`. Forms and castes are phenotype expressions only. Different-parent heritage remains controlled by the parent-race pair registry while retaining each selected subtype as the direct parent’s ancestry expression.

The resolved stat-block export records both direct parents, compatibility mode, creator deities, selected inherited traits, class/path features, spells, eight-axis alignment, covenant state, Beats, Guard, Stress, and Composure.
